## INCIDENT REPORT: NetSupport RAT Infection
**Evidence: 2024-11-26-traffic-analysis-exercise.pcap**

**IPv4 Address:** 10.11.26.183

**MAC Address:** 00:17:e0:b8:29:5e

**Windows Hostname:** DESKTOP-B8TQK49

**Domain:** nemotodes.health

**Logged-in User:** Oliver Q. Boomwald

**OS Fingerprint:** Windows NT 6.2 (Windows 8 or Server 2012), 64-bit architecture

---

### MALWARE CLASSIFICATION

**Malware Family:** NetSupport RAT (Remote Access Trojan)

**Attribution Confidence:** Signature-confirmed (Suricata/ET Pro IDS)

**Evidence:**
- User-Agent headers: "NetSupport Manager/1.3" in POST requests
- ETPRO TROJAN signatures: "NetSupport RAT CnC Activity" (Event #3.4022)
- ETPRO TROJAN signatures: "Malicious NetSupport Rat CnC Checkin" (Event #3.4023)
- ET INFO signatures: "NetSupport Remote Admin Checkin" (Event #3.4025)

---

### INDICATORS OF COMPROMISE (IOCs)

**Command and Control (C2) Endpoints:**
- 194.180.191.64:443 (primary C2 - NetSupport RAT beaconing)
- 193.42.38.139:443 (secondary C2/malicious content delivery)

**Malicious Domains:**
- modandcrackedapk.com (ZPHP malware signature, TLS SNI 193.42.38.139)

**Malicious URLs:**
- http://194.180.191.64/fakeurl.htm (C2 beacon endpoint - POST-based command polling)
- http://geo.netsupportsoftware.com/location/loca.asp (geolocation service lookup)

**C2 Communication Pattern:**
- Protocol: HTTP/HTTPS with encrypted payloads
- Request Headers: CMD=POLL (command polling), CMD=ENCD (encoded data), ES=1 (encryption enabled)
- Beaconing Interval: Approximately 60 seconds (consistent checkins from 08:50:45 through 09:22:50 UTC)
- Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded with binary-encoded payloads

**Additional Suspicious Infrastructure:**
- 104.26.1.231:80 (NetSupport GeoLocation Lookup Request)

**Transferred File Hashes:**
No clear-text executable files recovered from HTTP exports. All payloads encrypted/obfuscated with NetSupport Manager protocol encryption (ES=1 flag).

---

### NETWORK EXPLOITATION EVIDENCE

**Local Network Attacks (10.11.26.3 = Domain Controller):**
1. SMBv1 exploitation attempts on port 139
   - "SSL NETBIOS SMB Session Setup NTMLSSP unicode asn1 overflow attempt" (Event #3.3915)
   - "GPL NETBIOS SMB IPC$ unicode share access" (Event #3.3917)
   - "GPL NETBIOS SMB SMB_COM_TRANSACTION Max Data Count of 0 DOS Attempt" (Event #3.3918)

2. EFSR (Encrypting File System Remote) protocol abuse
   - "ETPRO POLICY [MS-EFSR] Microsoft Encrypting File System Remote Protocol Activity - [ncacn_np] EfsRpcOpenFileRaw M1" (Event #3.3883)

3. LDAP Active Directory enumeration queries to nemotodes-dc.nemotoads.health

---

### TIMELINE OF INFECTION

- **08:49:38 UTC** - Initial C2 contact to 194.180.191.64:443
- **08:50:14 UTC** - Malicious domain query (modandcrackedapk.com)
- **08:50:40 UTC** - TLS SNI connection to modandcrackedapk.com (193.42.38.139)
- **08:50:45 UTC** - First POST to C2 /fakeurl.htm (CMD=POLL polling begins)
- **08:50:46 UTC+** - Continuous C2 beaconing every 60 seconds through end of capture
- **08:50:45 UTC** - GeoLocation lookup to 104.26.1.231
- **08:49:50+ UTC** - Local network exploitation attempts (SMBv1, EFSR) against DC

### SUMMARY

This workstation (DESKTOP-B8TQK49) is infected with **NetSupport RAT**, a commodity remote access trojan commonly delivered via phishing or watering hole attacks. The attacker maintains persistent C2 connectivity to 194.180.191.64:443 with regular beacon polling every 60 seconds. The host also attempts exploitation of the local domain controller via SMBv1 and EFSR protocols, suggesting lateral movement objectives. The presence of modandcrackedapk.com (ZPHP cracked software distribution domain) indicates the infection vector likely involved trojanized software or malicious downloads.

**Immediate Actions Required:**
1. Isolate 10.11.26.183 from the network
2. Block traffic to 194.180.191.64 and 193.42.38.139 at the perimeter
3. Block DNS resolution to modandcrackedapk.com
4. Patch SMBv1 vulnerabilities on domain controller (10.11.26.3)
